courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 逆打工法地下結構
related.transfer: 可遷移「開挖尺度與地表影響」與「支撐拆換與荷載轉移」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；逆打工法地下結構的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Excavation scale and surface impact" and "Brace removal and load transfer" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Top-down underground construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦整合明挖隧道的地表界面、支撐、水壓與回填階段；逆打工法地下結構則以追蹤逆打樓板、預置柱與連續壁的分階段荷載為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on integrate surface interfaces, bracing, water pressure and backfilling in cut-and-cover tunnels; Top-down underground construction centres on track staged loads in top-down slabs, plunge columns and diaphragm walls, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「開挖尺度與地表影響」與「永久樓板的早期支撐」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到逆打工法地下結構，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「地下水卸載與地層回彈」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Excavation scale and surface impact” and “Permanent slabs as early braces”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Top-down underground construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Groundwater unloading and ground rebound", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 明挖覆蓋隧道施工
history.text: 本課討論的整合明挖隧道的地表界面、支撐、水壓與回填階段，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。大開挖公開資料列有明挖、沉管與頂進；帕丁頓專案團隊則說明永久樓板支撐連續壁的逆打選擇理由，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on integrate surface interfaces, bracing, water pressure and backfilling in cut-and-cover tunnels reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Big Dig public information lists cut-and-cover, immersed and jacked works; the Paddington project team explains choosing top-down construction with permanent slabs bracing diaphragm walls. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
